targets.rawSql:
WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(GREATEST($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, MIN(timestamp)), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS range_start,
    COALESCE(LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, MAX(timestamp)), $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS range_end
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware
  WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
),
time_grid AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    b.range_start,
    b.range_end,
    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)
  ) AS grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
)
SELECT 
  g.grid_time AS "time",
  AVG(hw.cpu_package_temp) AS "CPU 封装温度",
  AVG(hw.cpu_package_power) AS "CPU 封装功率"
FROM time_grid g
LEFT JOIN public.fact_system_hardware hw ON hw.timestamp >= g.grid_time 
  AND hw.timestamp < g.grid_time + GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

  CASE

    WHEN bool_or((hw.gpu_throttling_reasons & 132) > 0) THEN '⚡ 功耗墙'
    WHEN bool_or((hw.gpu_throttling_reasons & 8) > 0) THEN '🛑 硬件降速'
    WHEN bool_or((hw.gpu_throttling_reasons & 1) > 0) THEN '💤 空闲降频'
    WHEN count(hw.timestamp) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE '✅ 满血运行'
  END AS "GPU 降频状态" 
FROM time_grid g
LEFT JOIN public.fact_system_hardware hw ON hw.timestamp >= g.grid_time 
  AND hw.timestamp < g.grid_time + GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: 用户态调度抖动与上下文切换压力

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily_max_power AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('day', timestamp) AS day,
    MAX(cpu_package_power) AS max_cpu_pwr
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware
  WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY 1
),
daily_load_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('day', hw.timestamp) AS day,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dp.max_cpu_pwr > 40.0 AND hw.cpu_package_power >= 0.7 * dp.max_cpu_pwr THEN hw.cpu_package_temp ELSE NULL END) AS cpu_load_temp,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dp.max_cpu_pwr > 40.0 AND hw.cpu_package_power >= 0.7 * dp.max_cpu_pwr THEN hw.cpu_package_power ELSE NULL END) AS cpu_load_pwr,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dp.max_cpu_pwr > 40.0 AND hw.cpu_package_power >= 0.7 * dp.max_cpu_pwr THEN hw.cpu_clock_mhz ELSE NULL END) AS cpu_load_clock,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dp.max_cpu_pwr > 40.0 AND hw.cpu_package_power >= 0.7 * dp.max_cpu_pwr THEN hw.cpu_vcore_voltage ELSE NULL END) AS cpu_load_voltage
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware hw
  JOIN daily_max_power dp ON date_trunc('day', hw.timestamp) = dp.day
  WHERE hw.timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND hw.timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  day AS "time",
  cpu_load_temp AS "CPU 负载温度",
  cpu_load_pwr AS "CPU 负载功率",
  cpu_load_clock AS "CPU 负载主频",
  cpu_load_voltage AS "CPU 负载电压"
FROM daily_load_metrics
ORDER BY 1;

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily_max_power AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('day', timestamp) AS day,

  FROM public.fact_system_hardware
  WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY 1
),
daily_load_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('day', hw.timestamp) AS day,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dp.max_gpu_pwr > 80.0 AND hw.gpu_board_power >= 0.7 * dp.max_gpu_pwr THEN hw.gpu_core_temp ELSE NULL END) AS gpu_load_temp,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dp.max_gpu_pwr > 80.0 AND hw.gpu_board_power >= 0.7 * dp.max_gpu_pwr THEN hw.gpu_hotspot_temp ELSE NULL END) AS gpu_hotspot_load_temp,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dp.max_gpu_pwr > 80.0 AND hw.gpu_board_power >= 0.7 * dp.max_gpu_pwr THEN hw.gpu_board_power ELSE NULL END) AS gpu_load_pwr,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dp.max_gpu_pwr > 80.0 AND hw.gpu_board_power >= 0.7 * dp.max_gpu_pwr THEN hw.gpu_core_clock ELSE NULL END) AS gpu_load_clock,
    AVG(CASE WHEN dp.max_gpu_pwr > 80.0 AND hw.gpu_board_power >= 0.7 * dp.max_gpu_pwr THEN hw.gpu_core_voltage ELSE NULL END) AS gpu_load_voltage
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware hw
  JOIN daily_max_power dp ON date_trunc('day', hw.timestamp) = dp.day
  WHERE hw.timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND hw.timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  day AS "time",
  gpu_load_temp AS "GPU 核心负载温度",
  gpu_hotspot_load_temp AS "GPU 热点负载温度",
  gpu_load_pwr AS "GPU 负载功率",
  gpu_load_clock AS "GPU 负载时钟",
  gpu_load_voltage AS "GPU 负载电压"
FROM daily_load_metrics
ORDER BY 1;
